channel.title: McAmner Journal
channel.description: Films, books, music, objects, systems, and culture by Mattias Camner.

item.title: prompts are not loops
item.description: A note on the difference between asking an AI for an answer and building a loop that can inspect, verify, correct, and stop.
item.dc:creator: Mattias Camner

item.title: The Shards
item.description: The Shards is a note on FX's adaptation of Bret Easton Ellis's novel — memory, privilege and paranoia in Los Angeles, 1981.

item.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is a note on Peter Parker after the world forgets him — full-time responsibility, adult isolation, and a hero forced back to street level.
item.dc:creator: Mattias Camner

item.title: the whole path
item.description: A note on mq-ums, governed command paths, and why a working API function is not yet a working operational system.
item.dc:creator: Mattias Camner

item.title: false green
item.description: A note on checks that pass while the thing they were meant to protect is broken — and why a green light that measures the wrong thing is worse than no light at all.
item.dc:creator: Mattias Camner

item.title: the local model runtime
item.description: A note on the Ollama integration in mq-agent — named model profiles, a read-only command surface, and why the local model is treated as a component rather than the center of the system.
item.dc:creator: Mattias Camner

item.title: the learn loop
item.description: A note on making learning in local AI workflows deliberate, inspectable, and durable instead of accidental memory.

item.title: Excalidraw AI Proxy
item.description: A note on building an Excalidraw AI proxy: turning a local diagram tool into a structured interface for prompts, models, and commands.

item.title: CodeGraph
item.description: A note on CodeGraph, local source intelligence, and why it works best as a bounded hint inside the MQ stack rather than as a replacement for verification.

item.title: Cape Fear
item.description: Cape Fear is a note on the Apple TV series from Nick Antosca, with Javier Bardem, Amy Adams and Patrick Wilson turning a familiar revenge story into sustained pressure.

item.title: Red Wing Moc Toe
item.description: Red Wing Moc Toe Boot in Briar Oil Slick leather — a reliable boot that gets better with age, where expensive branded shoes only get uglier with time.
item.dc:creator: Mattias Camner

item.title: the map and the memory
item.description: Two memory layers for working with code and AI — CodeGraph indexes a repository into a queryable graph, and mqobsidian keeps decisions and learning records in a linked vault.
item.dc:creator: Mattias Camner

item.title: Gibson Les Paul Custom
item.description: Gibson Les Paul Custom is a note on the Black Beauty — a heavy, ornamented instrument where the gold, binding, and mahogany serve the sound as much as the look.

item.title: Back in Black
item.description: Back in Black is a note on AC/DC's 1980 album — discipline, volume, and the riff as total statement.

item.title: Beef S2
item.description: Beef S2 is a note on Lee Sung Jin's Netflix series — slower, more interior, closer in spirit to Apple TV+ prestige drama than anything else on the platform.

item.title: Spider-Man: Noir
item.description: Spider-Man: Noir is a note on the Netflix series, Nicolas Cage, 1930s New York, and what a superhero looks like when the city is already broken.

item.title: mq-mcp

item.title: mq-hal
